question:
Which letter cluster will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

MEND, MHNG, MKNJ, ?, MQNP
solution:
According to the English alphabet series and its positional value

 [IMAGE: https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/IIdSYb33Bqv49X8AJDy95H0A2wUUVqu2oeS2t_7SFYy4Dq_4T14MJNpfPGDv93XFebNIUtK7g6d1gCo-L_6MtGQUgIKIv3eU6HtEZDbthk0VYES5sE1zRRCsGswg6-PEt4L_aM3c] 

The given series is

MEND, MHNG, MKNJ, ?, MQNP

The pattern follows here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88f3d2f9156c20f820cad9e631e0ce03595f550fc1f719745d1f7ff36bf0b1a8.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **MNNM**.
